contexts.text: The river of Thy deliciousnesses () = the Spiritual of faith. ( = truth from the good of love. AE 483:10.) ( = intelligence and happiness. AE 1159:2.)
Filthy things from Hell are called rivers ().
The rivers of Egypt () = diverse false scientifics.
An inundating stream () = falsity. ( = what is scientific destroying the understanding of truth. AC 6015:4.) DFaith 53.
A stream of burning sulphur () = falsities from the evils of self love.
Rivers turned into blood = the truths of intelligence and wisdom falsified.
Streams = the things which are of intelligence; here, of insanity.
He hath established it upon the floods () = upon the things which are of intelligence. ( = upon the truths of faith. AC 9755:3. AE 275:9.) AE 518:23.
Every son... ye shall cast into the river () = that they should immerse all truths... in falsities.
The river of Egypt = falsity. Illustrated.
As the waters belong to the river, the river = falsity in general.
A great continuous stream of men from this world, seen.
Beyond the rivers of Cush () = to Knowledges by which they confirm false principles. AE 304:22.
She set it in the flag at the bank of the river () = among false scientifics. The river of Egypt = what is false.
Rivers () = the things of intelligence.
To wash at the river () = worship from what is false.
Her girls walked at the side of the river () = the ministries of that religiosity which was from what is false.
The Sensuous then dominates, and the interiors follow the force of the stream.
The bank of the river () = the state of falsity in which were those who infested.

Upon their streams, upon their rivers () = into the doctrinals of falsity... Streams and rivers, which are collections of water, = doctrinals; here, of falsity. Streams = the things of intelligence, thus those of truth; in the opposite, the things contrary to intelligence, thus those of falsity. AC 7383.
The waters, and rivers, of Egypt () = scientific truths.
The stream of Providence...
Rivers of living water () = Divine truth which is from the Lord alone (in abundance). AE 183:10.
From (an Angel's body) substances continually emane like a stream.
The floods came, and beat upon that house () = falsities in abundance... The floods also = temptations, which are inundations of falsities.
The serpent cast out... water as a flood () = reasonings from falsities in abundance. AE 763.
Carried away by a stream which sets towards Hell.
Spirits not yet initiated are urged on as by the force of a stream...
See River.
Like a stream of speech not understood...
As in a stream or river of ideas.
Not in the stream of their life.
The floods () = doctrinal things.
Rivers = the things of intelligence. AE 372:4.
A stream of fire issuing () = the Divine good of love; and the same going forth = the Divine truth proceeding.
The river of Egypt = intelligence procured by scientifics. (Compare AE 518:27.)
The magnificent Jehovah to us a place of rivers, of a stream ()... Rivers = wisdom; a stream, intelligence.
Rivers, and streams = the understanding of truth, and intelligence. Illustrated.
The Glorification of the Lord through truths which are of intelligence... is signified by, Let the floods clap their hands.
He shall drink of the stream in the way () = the Word in the letter.
A stream = ratiocination from falsities.
Hence temptations are signified by floods, etc.
A flood, etc. = evils and falsities.
The great river Euphrates () = man's Rational from knowledges. AE 569:4. (Compare AE 569:12.)
From the river to the ends of the earth () = the extension of rational and spiritual things.
Rivers out of the belly () = interior understanding or intelligence.
The streams shall recede () = that all things of spiritual intelligence will depart. AE 654:49.
The floods () which, here, are inundations of waters from rain, = temptations.
Streams = Own intelligence.
The rivers = reasonings.
